title: One for the Money
author: Janet Evanovich
summary: Stephanie Plum, recently laid off in New Jersey, blackmails her cousin into giving her a job as a bounty hunter. Her first target is Joe Morelli, a cop who once wronged her, and bodies begin to turn up.
readIf: you want a light, comic mystery with an unqualified but plucky heroine and quick pacing.
skipIf: you want a realistic procedural or a puzzle with tight clues.
